project.name: Example D2-LF
project.description: D2 on benchmark feeder lengths (validation case D2-LF: steady state). Same inverters, load and cable as D2 (N2XY 4×16 mm²); lengths from the residential feeder of the CIGRE LV benchmark (CIGRE TB 575, 2014, TF C6.04; segment lengths as in the pandapower implementation): main feeder 9 segments of 35 m, R1 to R10 = 315 m. Placement is a design choice: INV1 at the feeder head (R1), load at R6 (5 × 35 m = 175 m), INV2 at the feeder end (R10, 4 × 35 m = 140 m). Small-signal UNSTABLE under plain droop on the Real Engine: longer realistic feeders alone do not stabilise this design.
